fields.description: Copy: Creates duplicate documents on a recurring schedule. Reversal: Creates a single reversal entry on a scheduled date (Journal Entry only).
fields.label: Repeat Type

fields.description: Skip and disable this Auto Repeat if the source document is cancelled and no valid amendment is found.
fields.label: Skip if Source Cancelled

fields.description: If the source is cancelled, follow the amendment chain (amended_from) and use the latest non-cancelled version as the authoritative source.
fields.label: Follow Amendment Chain

fields.description: Latest authoritative source resolved on the last run. Updated automatically when the amendment chain is followed.
fields.label: Current Source Document

fields.description: Copy Original: All values copied as-is from source. Recalculate: Refreshes prices, FX, taxes, payment terms, shipping, and cost-center allocation for the new posting date. Switching to Recalculate auto-enables every individual switch below; switch them off again for fine-grained control.
fields.label: Refresh Mode

fields.description: Refresh item rates and price-list rates from the latest Price List for the new posting date.
fields.label: Refresh Prices from Price List

fields.description: Re-evaluate Pricing Rules against the new doc state during price refresh.
fields.label: Apply Pricing Rules

fields.description: Refresh the document conversion_rate and recompute base amounts using the FX rate valid for the new posting date.
fields.label: Refresh Exchange Rate

fields.description: Recalculate tax amounts based on the new posting date's tax rules.
fields.label: Recalculate Taxes

fields.description: Recompute the payment schedule against the new posting date and current Payment Terms Template.
fields.label: Recalculate Payment Terms

fields.description: Audit and apply Cost Center Allocation rules valid for the new posting date. Document-level cost center is unchanged; GL distribution is performed at posting time.
fields.label: Respect Cost Center Allocation

fields.description: Fetch the current default Sales Taxes and Charges Template for the customer/company and re-populate the taxes table. Applies to Sales Invoice, Sales Order, Quotation, Delivery Note.
fields.label: Refresh Sales Tax Template

fields.description: Fetch the current default Purchase Taxes and Charges Template for the supplier/company and re-populate the taxes table. Applies to Purchase Invoice, Purchase Order, Purchase Receipt.
fields.label: Refresh Purchase Tax Template

fields.description: Re-derive each item row's Item Tax Template from the Item master, respecting valid_from <= posting_date. Clears stale per-item exemptions when the Item master no longer has a matching template.
fields.label: Refresh Item Tax Template

fields.description: Re-apply the linked Shipping Rule against the new doc state so charges reflect current rates and conditions (weight, value, destination).
fields.label: Refresh Shipping Rule

fields.description: Schedule the reversal for the first day of the month following today. Overrides Reversal Date when checked.
fields.label: Reverse on First Day of Next Month

fields.description: Specific date on which the reversal should be created.
fields.label: Reversal Date

fields.description: Submit the generated reversal Journal Entry automatically. Leave off to create as draft for review.
fields.label: Auto Submit Reversal

fields.description: Original Rate: perfect offset (recommended for immutable ledger). Current Rate: revalues using the FX rate at the reversal posting date — creates an FX gain/loss.
fields.label: Exchange Rate for Reversal

fields.description: Use Original: reverse exact tax amounts (true reversal). Recalculate for Posting Date: log per-tax-account audit notes for review when current rates differ from the original.
fields.label: Reversal Tax Mode
fields.options:
Use Original
Recalculate for Posting Date

fields.description: Use Original: same cost centers as the source. Apply Current Allocation: audit cost-center rows against current Cost Center Allocation rules for the reversal date.
fields.label: Reversal Cost Center Mode
